mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM wms_warehouse WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT count(*) FROM wms_location WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT count(*) FROM wms_sku WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT count(*) FROM wms_customer WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT count(DISTINCT sku_id) FROM wms_inventory WHERE deleted = 0 AND on_hand_qty > 0 AND expire_date IS NOT NULL AND expire_date >= CURRENT_DATE AND expire_date <= CURRENT_DATE + 30
SELECT count(*) FROM wms_putaway_task WHERE status = 1
SELECT count(*) FROM wms_pick_task WHERE status IN (1, 2)
SELECT count(*) FROM wms_stocktake_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN (2, 3)

SELECT
i.warehouse_id COALESCE(s.category, '未分类') i.sku_id
AS groupKey,
w.name COALESCE(s.category, '未分类') CONCAT(s.code, ' ', s.name)
AS groupName, count(DISTINCT i.sku_id) AS skuCount, COALESCE(sum(i.on_hand_qty), 0) AS onHandQty, COALESCE(sum(i.locked_qty), 0) AS lockedQty, COALESCE(sum(i.on_hand_qty - i.locked_qty), 0) AS availableQty FROM wms_inventory i JOIN wms_sku s ON s.id = i.sku_id JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = i.warehouse_id WHERE i.deleted = 0
AND i.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
AND s.category = #{category}
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2

WITH periods AS ( SELECT
to_char(date_trunc('week', m.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
to_char(m.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'YYYY-MM')
to_char(m.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AS period, m.movement_type AS movement_type, m.qty_change AS qty_change, m.biz_no AS biz_no FROM wms_stock_movement m WHERE m.created_at >= #{start} AND m.created_at < #{end} AND m.movement_type IN (1, 2)
AND m.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
), inbound AS ( SELECT period, COALESCE(sum(qty_change), 0) AS inboundQty, count(DISTINCT biz_no) AS inboundOrders FROM periods WHERE movement_type = 1 GROUP BY period ), outbound AS ( SELECT period, COALESCE(sum(-qty_change), 0) AS outboundQty, count(DISTINCT biz_no) AS outboundOrders FROM periods WHERE movement_type = 2 GROUP BY period ) SELECT COALESCE(i.period, o.period) AS period, COALESCE(i.inboundQty, 0) AS inboundQty, COALESCE(i.inboundOrders, 0) AS inboundOrders, COALESCE(o.outboundQty, 0) AS outboundQty, COALESCE(o.outboundOrders, 0) AS outboundOrders FROM inbound i FULL OUTER JOIN outbound o ON o.period = i.period ORDER BY 1
